title: Global Quality Assurance Director - Specialty Chemicals
text:
This is an exciting role created to unify the Quality Assurance efforts and compliance for GMP and FDA Standards, as well as maintain ISO 9001 for the whole company including 12 manufacturing sites. You’ll lead non-conformance investigations, auditing for internal systems, and external suppliers. Plan and implement correction action training. Travel about 25% to other manufacturing sites in the USA. If you are looking for an established company with plans for growth, this could be an amazing new home!
 
 
Direct the Quality (QMS) program for all Global locations. Maintain suitable and effective Quality Management System based on ISO 9001, USP and GMP principles. Provide support to the Engineering, Commercial, and Production teams in solving internal and external quality, technical and engineering related issues. Manage customers’ complaints & other quality issues for all U.S. locations. 4 Plants in the USA, 5 in Europe, 2 in Chine, and 1 in Malaysia.
 
 
**Positional Responsibilities:**

* Direct the preparation and submission of all required reports to auditing and regulating agencies.
* Responsible for preparing all customer & internal quality complaint-related reports as required by management.
* Review and approve all monthly Quality Control and Assurance reports from all facilities for executive leadership team.
* Heads internal investigations into customer complaints and non-conformances as well as directing external investigations with customers into application problems to determine potential solutions.
* Travel to customer sites reviews customer operations and product requirements as required.
* Develop a supplier audit schedule annually and execute the schedule. This will be a combination of paper, virtual and in person audits based on the role and size of the supplier.
* Partner with customers to successfully integrate company product into customer processes.
* Support Quality and Technical Department investigations into customer application issues as well as internal instrumentation problems as needed.
* Conduct quarterly compliance audits for all US based facilities and facilitate international audits.
* Complete customer quality surveys and be the point of contact for customer audits and all 12 manufacturing-based facilities.
* This position requires monitoring production and other data to ensure all transactions meet all applicable quality regulations and requirements.
* Is authorized to release API grade products when the Quality Control Manager is not available for release approval.
* Create effective control structures that ensures not only legal compliance but more importantly the quality of all products and protection of the environments in which we operate. Parter with all levels of management to implement the structure creating and sustaining a culture where quality compliance is not only valued but expected.
* Responsible for reviewing new systems and processes to make sure proper management of change is documented and that there will be no impact to customer quality or determine if a customer needs to be notified of the change as it may impact the quality of material that they receive.
* Responsible for domestic and global compliance to Quality requirements, conduct or direct all quality activities, and compliance with any new laws.
* Other duties assigned by management.

Salary
 
 
$140,000 - $170,000
 
 
**Benefits**
Full suite of insurances benefits covered at 80% of cost, 3 weeks of vacation, 401k, profit sharing bonus, so much more!
 
 
**Experience:**

* Background & experience in Quality Management & Engineering with hands on experience with ISO 9001, USP and GMP systems \*Six Sigma Training - Black Belt preferred\*
* Background and competence in statistics and mathematics as used for quality control & assurance
* Experience in conducting internal audits as well as handling external audits.
* Supervisory experience in operating chemical test lab and lab personnel.
* Ability to train others.
* Extensive knowledge of the quality requirements of ISO and other global standards, as well as the experience in developing and implementing company systems and programs aligned with these standards.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Chemistry, or similar with 10 years of experience in quality / technical management in production and/or manufacturing environment.
* Experience managing non-conformances, negotiating technical issues, settling non-conformances and disputes in a favorable way.
* Must be able to travel to other locations, including outside the USA.
* Ability to implement and lead others to achieve a top-quality culture.
* Ability to meet and negotiate with customers and others on all issues including permits, required reports, and audit findings.
* Ability to read and understand regulations, interpret the applicability to our enterprise and operations, prepare applications and filings for permits or authorizations, create company policies and programs required for compliance, and communicate to all levels of management and personnel appropriately explaining the regulation and their role necessary to achieve and maintain compliance.
* Ability to direct supporting staff to achieve desired outcome - including the use of specialized techniques to arrive at solutions that will meet the company’s needs.
* If you’d like to hear more about this opportunity and others we are currently working on, please reach out to Stephanie Kemp at skemp@cps4jobs.com.
